safetyPage.title: Safety Guidelines
safetyPage.subtitle: Your safety is our top priority. Follow these essential tips for a secure and successful car buying or selling experience in Ethiopia.
safetyPage.meetPublicDesc: Always arrange meetings in busy, well-lit public places like shopping malls or gas stations.
safetyPage.inspectDesc: Never buy a car without seeing it in person and having a trusted mechanic inspect it.
safetyPage.securePaymentsDesc: Avoid wire transfers or paying in advance. Use secure bank transfers once the deal is finalized.
safetyPage.verifyDocsDesc: Check the vehicle registration, service history, and ownership documents carefully.
safetyPage.bewareScamsDesc: If a deal seems too good to be true, it probably is. Never share your OTP or bank details with anyone claiming to be from EthioCars.

about.title: About Us
about.p1: EthioCars Marketplace is a modern digital platform built to make buying and selling cars in Ethiopia simple, fast, and secure. The app connects car buyers and sellers in one trusted marketplace where users can explore a wide range of vehicles, from budget-friendly cars to premium models.
about.p2: With EthioCars Marketplace, users can easily browse car listings, view detailed vehicle information, chat directly with sellers, and post their own cars for sale within minutes.
about.p3: The platform is designed specifically for the Ethiopian market, making it easier for people to find cars in their city or nearby locations.
about.feature1: Browse thousands of car listings across Ethiopia
about.feature2: Post your car for sale quickly and easily
about.feature3: View detailed car information including condition, price, and location
about.feature4: Chat directly with buyers and sellers inside the app
about.feature5: Save cars to your favorites or wishlist
about.feature6: Fast search and category filtering to find the perfect car.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.text: At EthioCars, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you as to how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

data.title: 2. Data We Collect
data.text: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
items: Identity Data includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier.
Contact Data includes email address and telephone numbers.
Technical Data includes internet protocol (IP) address, your login data, browser type and version.
Usage Data includes information about how you use our website and services.

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
usage.text: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
items: To register you as a new customer.
To process and deliver your listings.
To manage our relationship with you.
To improve our website, services, marketing and customer relationships.

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.text: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed.

agreement.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
agreement.text: By accessing or using EthioCars, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you are prohibited from using or accessing this site.

license.title: 2. Use License

conduct.title: 3. User Conduct
conduct.text: Users are responsible for the content they post. You agree not to post any content that is:
